Sample Club

Membership Terms and Conditions

Last updated: 1 August 2026. These terms apply to every Sample Club membership.

1 Membership

Your membership starts on the day you sign up and gives you access to member prices, free delivery on orders above ₹499 and early access to sales. A membership is personal and can't be transferred to anyone else. We may refuse or end a membership that is used to resell goods.

2 Fees

The membership fee is ₹199 per month, charged in advance on the same date each month. The first month is free for new members. Fees are shown including GST. We may change the fee for future months with 14 days' notice by email.

3 Automatic payments

Fees are collected by auto-debit from the card or UPI AutoPay mandate you set up when you join. You authorise us to retry a failed debit up to three times in a month. If a debit fails, your membership benefits are paused until the fee is paid.

4 Renewal

Your membership renews automatically every month until you cancel it. We will not send a reminder before each renewal. The renewal uses the same payment method unless you change it in your account.

5 Cancellation

You may cancel your membership by giving 30 days' notice through the account page or by email to help@sample-club.example. A cancellation fee of ₹299 applies if you cancel within the first three months. Fees already paid are not refunded.

6 Early repayment of instalments

If you bought items with member instalments, you can repay the balance early after the first two instalments. A foreclosure charge of 3% of the outstanding amount applies to early repayment.

7 Your data

We share your name, contact details and order history with our partners and affiliates, including for marketing. You can opt out of marketing messages at any time, but sharing needed to run your membership continues.

8 Disputes

Any dispute about these terms goes to arbitration by a single arbitrator chosen by us, with the seat in Mumbai. You agree not to join a class action against us.
